title: GAO: Artificial Intelligence Acquisitions — Phase 65 GSA post-quantum acquisition review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the GSA post-quantum acquisition reporting pack. GAO reviewed 13 AI acquisitions at DOD, DHS, GSA, and VA and found that the agencies used multiple acquisition approaches but did not systematically collect and apply lessons learned.
key_findings: The review covered 13 acquisitions at four agencies through fiscal year 2025.
Agencies used contracts, schedules, and other acquisition approaches with different trade-offs.
GAO made four recommendations requiring systematic collection and sharing of acquisition lessons.
why_it_matters: Which records move a migration obligation through inventory, solicitation, award, interoperability test, cutover, acceptance, rollback, and legacy retirement? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. This record advances institutional ai and cybersecurity operation from upstream activity into a named operating, measurement, or explicit comparison-boundary record.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of eight Phase 55Z records for institutional ai and cybersecurity operation.
Keeps unit, period, geography, and method attached to the reported result.
Identifies the next record needed before any cross-system comparison.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
Acquisition activity is not deployment success or measured mission benefit.
The selected acquisitions do not represent every federal AI acquisition.
